text:
Maria: Hey team — quick Q: where do I find per-dedicated-pool traces + autoscale graphs for eu-west-1? Need to investigate a recent spike where requests queued but pool didn't scale. Also want to propose a tweak to pool-saturation alert.

Jamal: Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/pools/dedicated-capacity?orgId=1 — panels 'Pool Autoscale Overview' and 'Per-Pool Traces (tail)'. Jaeger for traces: https://jaeger.internal/search?service=pool-runner&tags=eu-west-1

Jamal: Quick PromQL to see per-pool in-flight + alloc:
```promql
sum by (pool) (pool_requests_in_flight) or sum by (pool) (pool_allocated_capacity)
```

Dan: For alerting I usually look at `pool_saturation_ratio` and `pool_ready_count`. Example rule we used in staging:
```yaml
- alert: PoolHighSaturation
  expr: avg_over_time(pool_saturation_ratio{env="prod",region="eu-west-1"}[2m]) > 0.85
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Pool {{ $labels.pool }} high saturation"
```

Dan: Also watch `pool_steal_queue_seconds` — if that's spiking, scaling won't help until steal clears.

Maria: Where are the k8s pod logs for the runner? Want last hour logs.

Jamal: `kubectl -n dedicated logs -l app=pool-runner,region=eu-west-1 -c runner --since=1h | tail -n 200`

Sarah: I put an infra PR with a tuned alert proposal: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 — includes a suggested ramp-up policy + a canary rule for 1 pool first. Please review :eyes:

ci-bot: Build passed for infra PR #1234 :white_check_mark:

Maria: Thanks — I'll attach the Grafana snapshot from the spike and tag the pool ID. pinging @Jamal and @Dan for eyeballs. :thumbsup:

Jamal: Looking now, will add a note in the PR with the trace link and a sample trace id.

Dan: I'll do a quick alert rules pass tomorrow morning and mark the PR ready. :ok_hand:
